flagged.title: Factors Affecting Criminal Behaviour
flagged.reason: The video states that self-report studies show working-class overrepresentation in offending, which is factually incorrect and directly penalised on GCSE questions evaluating crime measurement methods.

mark_affecting.quote: Both police records and self-report studies show working-class individuals are highly overrepresented when it comes to street crime and theft.

flagged.title: Public Debates About Crime
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly misapplies Charles Murray's concept of 'dependency culture' (a welfare state/underclass concept) to criminal sentencing, which misleads GCSE students on core sociological terminology.

mark_affecting.quote: believing that lenient sentencing just encourages a dependency culture, where offenders never face enough consequences
